name: frappe-copilot
description: AI-powered Frappe/ERPNext development assistant. Integrates with OpenCode Zen for agentic code generation, bench management, and Frappe app scaffolding.

enumDescriptions: Extra thorough — best for hard coding tasks
frappe-copilot.effort.description: How much reasoning effort the model spends. Leave empty to use each model's default. Applies to Claude models with effort support and to OpenAI reasoning models (gpt-5, o-series); ignored for models without it.

frappe-copilot.browser.executablePath.description: Chrome/Chromium/Edge/Brave executable the agent's browser tool drives. Leave empty to auto-detect an installed one.

frappe-copilot.browser.headless.description: Run the agent's browser without a visible window. Keep it off to watch the agent and to log in to sites yourself (the login persists in ~/.frappe-copilot/browser-profile).

enumDescriptions: Brave/Tavily when an API key is set (Frappe Copilot: Set Web Search API Key, or BRAVE_API_KEY / TAVILY_API_KEY), otherwise DuckDuckGo.
DuckDuckGo's HTML page — no key, but it sometimes blocks automated searches.
frappe-copilot.webSearch.provider.description: Which search service the agent's web_search tool uses.

frappe-copilot.webSearch.searxngUrl.description: Base URL of a SearXNG instance with the JSON format enabled, e.g. https://searx.example.com.

frappe-copilot.nativeToolCalling.description: Use the provider's native function-calling API (Anthropic tool_use / OpenAI tool_calls) instead of the XML text protocol. Falls back to XML automatically if a model rejects tools.

frappe-copilot.toolImages.description: Let tools hand images to the model — browser screenshots and read_file on an image. Turned off automatically for a model that rejects images.

frappe-copilot.reviewChanges.description: Track every file the agent edits for review: accept or reject its changes per hunk (CodeLens in the editor, Alt+Enter / Shift+Alt+Backspace), per file, or all at once from the bar above the chat input. Edits are applied right away either way; rejecting restores the file as it was before the agent touched it.

frappe-copilot.runLimits.pauseAfterSteps.description: Pause a request after this many agent steps and ask whether to continue (each Continue doubles the limit). 0 turns it off.

frappe-copilot.runLimits.pauseAfterToken.description: Pause a request once it has used this many tokens (input + output, summed over every model call) and ask whether to continue. 0 turns it off.

enumDescriptions: Anthropic Claude API (direct, manual API key or OAuth login)
Claude Code (official @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk — same login/API mechanism as the Claude Code VS Code extension; no key entry needed)
frappe-copilot.provider.description: LLM provider to use for chat and code generation

enumDescriptions: Ask before every high-risk action (writing/editing files, running commands, accessing paths outside the workspace, running verification)

Run everything automatically with no approval prompts. The agent can overwrite files and execute shell/bench commands without confirmation — only use this in a workspace whose changes you can revert (e.g. a clean git tree)
frappe-copilot.approvalMode.description: Whether high-risk agent actions require your approval, or run automatically

frappe-copilot.opencodeZen.model.description: Default model to use with OpenCode Zen

frappe-copilot.openai.model.description: Default model to use with OpenAI

frappe-copilot.anthropic.model.description: Default model to use with Anthropic

frappe-copilot.anthropic.extendedThinkin.description: Turn on Claude's thinking for models where it is optional (Opus 4.7/4.8, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5 and older). Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Sonnet 5.x and Fable always think; their thinking is shown either way. Control how deeply models think with the Effort picker next to the model.

frappe-copilot.anthropic.thinkingBudgetT.description: Thinking budget for older models that still use one (Haiku 4.5, Opus/Sonnet 4.5 and earlier). Current models think adaptively and use Effort instead.

frappe-copilot.claudeCode.executablePath.description: Path to your own `claude` CLI for the Claude Code provider (e.g. ~/.local/bin/claude). Leave empty to use the CLI bundled with the extension. Set this when a newly released model needs a newer Claude Code than the bundled one.

frappe-copilot.claudeCode.model.description: Default model to use with the Claude Code provider

frappe-copilot.claudeCode.extendedThinki.description: Turn on Claude's thinking for models where it is optional (Opus 4.7/4.8, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5 and older). Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Sonnet 5.x and Fable always think; their thinking is shown either way. Control how deeply models think with the Effort picker next to the model.

frappe-copilot.claudeCode.thinkingBudget.description: Thinking budget for older models that still use one (Haiku 4.5, Opus/Sonnet 4.5 and earlier). Current models think adaptively and use Effort instead.

frappe-copilot.multiAgent.enabled.description: Legacy mode. By default a single main agent with every tool handles each request and delegates to specialist sub-agents itself via the task tool. Enable this to instead route each request to a task-specialized agent (DocType/Schema Builder, Server-side Logic, Client-side/UI, Bench/DevOps & Debug, Research, Architecture/Planning) instead of one general-purpose agent, and recognize multi-domain requests as an ordered multi-agent pipeline. Each agent run offers to self-verify (bench migrate + any existing tests, with a few bounded self-correction attempts on failure) before reporting done. Requests that don't confidently match a specialist still fall back to the General agent.

frappe-copilot.contextWindowTokens.description: Context window of the active model, in tokens. 0 = detect from the model id (Claude 200k, GPT-5 400k, GPT-4o 128k, …). Drives the context badge, compaction thresholds, and when older tool output is cleared during long runs.

frappe-copilot.compaction.thresholdToken.description: Token count of conversation history above which Frappe Copilot offers to compact it. Leave unset to use 50% of the active model's context window (history past 80% is compacted automatically). Compaction only ever summarizes what gets sent going forward — the full raw conversation on disk is never deleted.

frappe-copilot.compaction.autoOffer.description: Show a dismissible banner offering to compact the conversation once it crosses the token threshold. Compaction is never applied automatically without this prompt — you can always trigger it manually via /compact regardless of this setting.

frappe-copilot.intake.extractImages.description: When analyzing an uploaded PDF, also extract embedded diagram/screenshot images and send them to the model alongside the text (requires a vision-capable model for real benefit). Disable if this causes packaging/performance issues in your environment.

frappe-copilot.intake.maxExtractedImages.description: Maximum number of embedded images to extract from a single uploaded PDF (cost/latency control — each image is sent to the model as a vision attachment).
